title: BetaManagedAgentsToolUseLimitReachedError
description: The turn stopped because the agent loop reached its limit on tool-use rounds (one model response that calls tools, plus running those tools, is one round), not because a request failed. The thread goes idle with `stop_reason: retries_exhausted` (a child thread then terminates); the next `user.message` starts a new turn.

examples: This turn stopped because the agent loop reached its limit of 500 tool-use rounds since the turn started or last resumed. A round is one model response that calls tools, plus running those tools. Nothing failed. Send the session a new message to continue; nothing from the stopped turn is discarded.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.
